# Invois

> Invois is an Android app for Malaysia that makes itemised quotations from your own price list, then turns a quotation into an invoice and a receipt, one tap each, shared as a PDF. It is for anyone who quotes and bills their own jobs, from a plumber or a tutor to a photographer or a programmer. Made by EONGERRA TECH, Subang Jaya. The name is the Malay word for invoice. Invois is not affiliated with LHDN and is not part of MyInvois, LHDN's e-Invoice system.

- Platform: Android, on Google Play (package com.invoisapp), available in Malaysia only. There is no iPhone version yet.
- Free plan: no sign-up needed to start. Quotations, invoices, customers and the price list are unlimited, with 15 AI actions a month, or 30 a month after phone verification. Free documents carry a small "Made with invoisapp.com" line.
- Invois Pro: RM 19.90 a month or RM 190 a year, billed by Google Play. Pro gives 300 AI actions a month and removes the footer line; nothing else changes.
- Languages: the app is in Bahasa Melayu, English and Chinese. Documents sent to customers have English labels (Quotation, Invoice, Receipt).
- Features: itemised quotations picked from your price list, with a note under each item; voice input in Malay, English or Chinese, mixed in one sentence; deposits, instalments and partial payments, with one receipt per payment; AI reads a photo of a bank-transfer slip; a reminder button on overdue invoices that opens WhatsApp with the message filled in; AI-drafted terms and conditions; SST as its own line and SSM, TIN and SST numbers on the letterhead; invoices exported as PDFs for your accountant.
- Not in the app: it does not submit e-Invoices to MyInvois or file anything with LHDN. It has no credit or debit notes, and an invoice cannot be cancelled or voided.
- Contact: support@eongerra.com

## Guides in English

- [All guides in English](https://invoisapp.com/guides/): free guides for the self-employed in Malaysia

- [How to Write a Quotation in Malaysia (With Examples)](https://invoisapp.com/guides/how-to-write-a-quotation/): what a quotation needs (SSM number, SST, validity, payment terms), with an example
- [How to Make a Service Price List: Format and Example (Malaysia)](https://invoisapp.com/guides/how-to-make-a-price-list/): what goes on each line, how to choose the unit, and an example list
- [Quotation Terms and Conditions: 20 Examples (Malaysia)](https://invoisapp.com/guides/quotation-terms-and-conditions/): clauses to copy for deposits, payment, scope, cancellation and warranty
- [How to Write an Invoice in Malaysia (With Examples)](https://invoisapp.com/guides/how-to-write-an-invoice/): number, due date, SSM number, SST and payment details, and when e-Invoice applies
- [How to Write a Receipt in Malaysia (With Examples)](https://invoisapp.com/guides/how-to-write-a-receipt/): receipt number, date paid, amount in words and balance, with a deposit example
- [Quotation vs Invoice vs Receipt in Malaysia (With Example)](https://invoisapp.com/guides/quotation-vs-invoice-vs-receipt/): one job followed from quotation to deposit, balance and official receipt
- [Cash Sales vs Invoice: What Is a Cash Bill in Malaysia?](https://invoisapp.com/guides/cash-sales-vs-invoice/): what a cash bill is and when to use one instead of an invoice
- [Customer Not Paying? What to Do in Malaysia (5 Steps)](https://invoisapp.com/guides/customer-not-paying/): 5 steps from reminders to a letter of demand and small claims for RM 5,000 or less
- [Do I Need to Register with SSM? Who Must, Cost and How](https://invoisapp.com/guides/do-i-need-to-register-with-ssm/): who must register, who is exempt, the cost from RM 30 a year and how to apply
- [Do I Need to Charge SST? Guide for Self-Employed in Malaysia](https://invoisapp.com/guides/do-i-need-to-charge-sst/): the RM 500,000 registration threshold, which services are taxed at 8% or 6%, and what the invoice shows
- [Business Expenses You Can Claim on Form B in Malaysia](https://invoisapp.com/guides/business-expenses-form-b/): what you can and cannot deduct, how equipment is claimed and what records to keep
- [How to File Form B in Malaysia: Deadline and e-Filing Steps](https://invoisapp.com/guides/how-to-file-form-b/): e-Filing steps, the deadline, the accounts it asks for and the penalties for filing late
- [Form B P&L and Balance Sheet: Each e-B Field in English](https://invoisapp.com/guides/form-b-profit-loss-balance-sheet/): each Malay e-B field explained in English, with a freelancer's figures
- [Tax Relief for the Self-Employed in Malaysia (YA 2026)](https://invoisapp.com/guides/tax-relief-self-employed/): personal reliefs on Form B for 2026, including EPF and life insurance up to RM 7,000 together
- [CP500 LHDN: What It Is, Due Dates and How to Pay](https://invoisapp.com/guides/what-is-cp500/): the notice to pay income tax in 6 instalments, the due dates, paying at ByrHASiL and revising with CP502
- [What Is a Purchase Order (PO)? PO vs Quotation in Malaysia](https://invoisapp.com/guides/what-is-a-purchase-order/): what a PO is, what to check against your quotation, what to do if it differs, and the PO number on your invoice
